name: HIGH_PRIEST_LINEN_GARMENT
canonical: a plain undyed white linen tunic, sash, breeches and turban-mitre, simple and servant-humble, with no gold and no jewels — the Day of Atonement linen the high priest wore into the holy place, NOT the gold ephod and breastplate, NOT an ornate robe
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
